review_notes: I read the whole file. It has one new definition, `holedDisc`. It is the intersection of `closedSubdisc a c` with a finite family of valuative-inequality sets. This is a specific geometric object in the closed unit disc of Spa. I know of no Mathlib counterpart: Mathlib has no holed discs, annuli or closed unit disc in Spa. The definition is built from existing operations (`∩`, `⋂`, `ValuativeRel.vle`) and from the library's own `closedSubdisc`, `C` and `T`. It does not introduce a competing representation of anything in Mathlib. The remaining declarations are theorems, which the rubric excludes. The two private lemmas `setOf_vle_eq_basicOpen` and `setOf_vle_eq_rationalSubset` are also theorems. I did not open the Mathlib sources, so I have not ruled out a hidden duplicate there.
